subject: OPUS-5 / OPUS-6 DIRECTIVES: Pull SHA 91dd7b19a (0 Type Errors) + Conjunction Gate & Signal Pipeline Integration
body:
OPUS DIRECTIVES (Active & Queued):

1. ACTIVE (OPUS-5):
- Pull origin/claude/signal-architecture-rebuild-bq7l8i at SHA 91dd7b19a.
- Verify npm run typecheck is 100% green across all workspaces. All 31 remaining typecheck errors are completely resolved (Option a: 19 signal definitions aligned to Prisma SignalCategory enums; SignalOutputKind widened; grouping.ts made self-contained).
- Wire public-surface-truth staleness monitor and AST dynamic import verification.

2. QUEUED BACKLOG (OPUS-6):
- Conjunction Gate Walk-Forward Benchmark:
  * Connect signal-path trueProb with our 21 situational signals across historical decided picks (n=901 decided, 368 positive CLV).
  * Verify that independentEdge.decision === 'PASS' rows are NEVER minted or published.
  * Evaluate Brier score improvement when combining market fair prob with multi-signal situational edge.

3. QUEUED BACKLOG (OPUS-7):
- Wire evaluated signals into generate-signal-slate.ts behind kill-switch CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED (no shadow period, per v5.3.0 build spec).
- Enforce the MODEL_VERSION = 'v5.2.7' invariant.
